utm_campaign_convention: Auto-tagging (gclid) sets campaign from the Ads campaign name. If also tagging manually, use a campaign-level custom parameter {_campaign} = objective_offer_yyyymm
notes: Keep auto-tagging ON. It is required for GA4 ↔ Ads conversion import. Manual UTMs are a backup for non-GA4 tools (CRM first-touch capture).
Nothing to tag. Shown here so the grouping table is complete.

utm_campaign_convention: {{campaign.name}} — name campaigns objective_offer_yyyymm in Ads Manager
notes: site_source_name resolves to fb / ig / an / msg. The grouping regex matches all four exactly. Set in Ads Manager → Ad → URL parameters.
Use full words (facebook / instagram) for organic so paid (fb / ig) and organic stay distinguishable in raw source reports too.

Hard-code utm_source=threads in a Threads-only ad set. Don't rely on {{site_source_name}} here. Check what it returns for Threads placements before trusting it, because if it returns a Meta code the session groups as Meta.
Untagged clicks arrive as threads.net / threads.com / l.threads.com referrals. The grouping catches all of them as Threads, checked before Meta.

Many Xiaohongshu ad formats keep users in-app (lead forms / private messages), so site sessions undercount. Reconcile against platform-side lead counts. Confirm the landing-page URL field accepts query strings before launch.
External links in notes are heavily restricted, so most traffic arrives untagged via xhslink.com or as Direct. The grouping catches xiaohongshu / xhslink / xhs / rednote.
Set URL parameters on each ad, or use Campaign Manager's dynamic UTM option if enabled on the account. Lead Gen Form leads never hit the site, so they need a CRM sync instead of UTMs.
Untagged LinkedIn clicks arrive as linkedin.com / referral or lnkd.in / referral. The grouping catches both as LinkedIn.

utm_content_use: video ID or hook variant (hook_a / hook_b)
notes: YouTube ads run through Google Ads. With auto-tagging on, GA4 may still attribute them to google / cpc. Verify in GA4 before relying on the YouTube Paid bucket (see case study gaps).
Untagged clicks arrive as youtube.com / referral or m.youtube.com / referral. The grouping catches both.
medium = email is what routes to the Email bucket. Source can be any list name. Most ESPs can append these automatically.
Checked before Google in the grouping so mail.google.com sources never count as Google.
Not taggable. Rising Direct share usually means untagged links somewhere (PDFs / apps / Slack). Audit with this sheet.

utm_campaign_convention: lowercase, hyphens inside words, underscores between parts: objective_offer_yyyymm
utm_content_use: describe the variant not the platform
notes: Never UTM-tag internal links (it restarts the session and overwrites the real source). Paid medium values must match the Traffic Type regex: cpc / ppc / cpm / cpv / display / paid_*.
